availableCommands.name: android-code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory Android quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing Android Kotlin, Compose UI, manifests, resources, or instrumented tests.

availableCommands.name: code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory code quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing code.

availableCommands.name: customize-opencode
availableCommands.description: Use ONLY when the user is editing or creating opencode's own configuration: opencode.json, opencode.jsonc, files under .opencode/, or files under ~/.config/opencode/. Also use when creating or fixing opencode agents, subagents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, or permission rules. Do not use for the user's own application code, or for any project that is not configuring opencode itself.

availableCommands.name: data-visualization
availableCommands.description: Design or critique quantitative data visualizations. Use for charts, dashboards, and dense analytical displays.

availableCommands.name: decompilation
availableCommands.description: Analyze application packages, bytecode, native binaries, and embedded firmware to reconstruct behavior from reproducible evidence. Use for authorized decompilation, protocol extraction, and call-flow analysis.

availableCommands.name: go-code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory Go quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing Go code.

availableCommands.name: phased-implementation-planning
availableCommands.description: Create concise dependency-ordered implementation plans when work needs multiple independently useful phases.

availableCommands.name: playwright-cli
availableCommands.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

availableCommands.name: playwright-component-testing
availableCommands.description: Set up component testing with Playwright using a story gallery — scaffold stories and a gallery dev page driven by the built-in mount fixture, no dedicated component-testing runtime. Use when asked to test React or Vue components in isolation with Playwright, or to migrate off @playwright/experimental-ct-react / -vue.

availableCommands.name: playwright-trace
availableCommands.description: Inspect Playwright trace files from the command line — list actions, view requests, console, errors, snapshots and screenshots.

availableCommands.name: procedural-music-generation
availableCommands.description: Compose reproducible music with code-driven synthesis and arrangement. Use when generating or revising procedural audio tracks or scene-timed scores.

availableCommands.name: programmatic-social-video
availableCommands.description: Build reproducible short-form videos from supplied media with a code-driven timeline. Use when creating or revising social-video edits, captions, motion, audio, or delivery renders.

availableCommands.name: python-code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory Python quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing Python code.

availableCommands.name: shell-code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory quality rules for Bash and POSIX shell code. Load before writing, debugging, or reviewing scripts, CI shell commands, launchers, or cleanup automation.

availableCommands.name: skill-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory instruction-quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing skills, their metadata, or supporting references.

availableCommands.name: typescript-code-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory TypeScript quality rules. Load before writing or reviewing TypeScript code.

availableCommands.name: web-frontend-quality
availableCommands.description: Mandatory quality rules for writing or reviewing browser frontends, including component styling, accessibility, reactive rendering, visualization integrity, bundle behavior, and browser verification. Use alongside the applicable language-quality skill. Do not use for server-side TypeScript or non-web UI code.
